step1_analysis.description: This circuit is an active coupling network for an in-phase injection-coupled Quadrature Voltage-Controlled Oscillator (QVCO). It uses diode-connected transistors and cross-connections to synchronize the phases of the coupled oscillators.

paper_reference.title: A 57.9-to-68.3GHz 24.6mW Frequency Synthesizer with In-Phase Injection-Coupled QVCO in 65nm CMOS

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the coupling network.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total ≈ I_PMOS + I_NMOS. With VDD=1.8V and Vbias=0.9V, total current is approx 0.5mA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 24.6mW for the entire synthesizer. The coupling network alone consumes a small fraction of this.

z11_60GHz.description: Input impedance magnitude at the primary tank node (N1) at the operating frequency of 60GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominated by parasitic capacitance at 60GHz. C_total ≈ 150fF. Z = 1/(2*pi*60G*150f) ≈ 17 ohms = 24 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At mm-wave frequencies, the impedance is heavily degraded by the large number of parallel transistor parasitics.

z21_60GHz.description: Transfer impedance magnitude from N1 to N0 at 60GHz, representing the coupling strength.

sky130_expected.calculation: Z21 = Gm * Z_N0 * Z11. With Gm ≈ 2.6mS and Z_N0 ≈ 50 ohms, Z21 ≈ 2.2 ohms = 6.8 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Coupling strength depends on the transconductance of the coupling transistors and the node impedances at 60GHz.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power and AC impedances (Z11, Z21) at 60GHz for the QVCO coupling network.
